title: Mahj League
oneLiner: Web page that keeps weekly standings for American mahjong clubs and leagues, points only, no app install
customer: Organisers of American mahjong clubs, open play nights and leagues in the US
revenueModel: Paid season unlock per club; free single-game score sheet as the search magnet

evidence.claim: Public radio reported in Jan 2026 that a century old tile game, mahjong, is suddenly drawing younger players and new clubs across the US.
People buy printable American mahjong score cards and hand trackers on Etsy even though free scoring calculators exist.
A dedicated club and league app for American mahjong now exists on the App Store, showing organisers want league tooling.

Troop Mahjong sells a 4 week American mahjong league in Northborough MA at $70 to $115 per player, scores it exclusively through MahWins and bundles an app download code, showing organisers run paid leagues and need standings tooling.
Wild & Precious Collective sells a 4 week mahjong league at $30 a week or $100 for all four, with placement points, ladder rankings and standings kept in a custom league app.

MahWins, a $2.99 iPhone only mahjong game tracker, added league organiser features (add players, claim games, league rules) with a group leaderboard, showing paid demand for league tracking but no web or Android version.
AMR Authority launched a free iOS ranking app for American mahjong with a $4.99 a month AMR+ tier; it ranks individual players by Elo and does not describe club or league standings.
A US organiser on the Reach Mahjong forum asks how to start and structure a mahjong league where American style is the norm, with weekly seating by team and rating.

nextAction: Validated by Navya on 2026-11-15. Needs: Research writes cases/mahj-league.md, Sizing writes cases/mahj-league.sizing.json, CEO go decision. Gap: league standings for American mahjong cost $57.99/mo at Mahjic Pro (free plan has no leagues) or need every player on an iPhone with a $2.99 MahWins purchase; no web, any phone, no install club standings tool found. Evidence against: (1) Mahjic, MahWins and AMR Authority are active, funded or shipping fast in this exact niche, and Mahjic claims 400+ clubs, so distribution is contested; (2) generic free web leaderboards exist (keepthescore free plan has 2 scoreboards, https://keepthescore.com/pricing), so a casual club can make do; (3) PartyPot offers free club season leaderboards for game groups (https://partypotapp.com.advisoryapps.com/business/leaderboard/); (4) the paid leagues found are small local 4 week events, so per club willingness to pay for a tool is unproven, and the leagues found already chose an app; (5) no sourced search volume found for league terms (mahjong league scoring, mahjong league score sheet); page one for those is Etsy printables, a NZ club PDF, mahjong4friends.com and mahjongg.ai.studio, so small sites can rank but the volume may be tiny. Research must quantify volume before the case clears. Legal: points only, never money or stakes, never reproduce the NMJL card.
